S001-lemma-additivity-loc-chern-c.h3_criterion_note:
【决定性的一步是什么】本条断言的是 distinguished triangle 上局部化 Chern 类的乘性；在允许引用 pre-sum-c（它只覆盖直和 $Q \oplus Q'$）之后，使断言成立的那一步是：把一个抽象的 distinguished triangle 归约为直和情形。本证明为这一步自造了一个形变对象与形变机制——$X' = \mathbf{A}^1 \times X$、$Z' = \mathbf{A}^1 \times Z$、以 $t$ 为 $\mathbf{A}^1$ 坐标，取映射 $t g^*\varphi^\bullet : g^*\mathcal{E}_3^\bullet[-1] \to g^*\mathcal{E}_1^\bullet$ 的锥 $\mathcal{C}^\bullet$（11385–11401），核对它满足局部化 Chern 类有定义的条件（11401–11410），识别两端纤维 $\mathcal{C}^\bullet|_{t = 0}$ 为 $\mathcal{E}_1^\bullet \oplus \mathcal{E}_3^\bullet$（11415–11417）、$\mathcal{C}^\bullet|_{t = 1}$ 为表示 $E_2$ 的有界 f.l.f. 复形（11424–11427），再经 base change 相容与 $i_0^* = i_1^*$ 得到 $c^{(p_1 + p_3)}(Z \to X, E_2) = c^{(p_1 + p_3)}(Z \to X, E_1 \oplus E_3)$（11418–11439）。

【谁承担：本证明。三条可复核依据】(1) 被引件无一交付这一步。全库 grep：字符串「t g^*\varphi^\bullet」只出现在 chow.tex 11390、11415、11425（即只在本证明内），「Consider the cone」在 chow.tex 只出现在 11387（derived.tex:3933、derived.tex:6920、dga.tex:2775、sdga.tex:4429 的锥是无关的一般同调代数语境）。本证明引用的 10 个不同标签逐条落地核对：pre-sum-c（10498–10600）以 $c^{(p + p')}(Q \oplus Q') = c^{(p)}(Q)c^{(p')}(Q')$ 为结论，只处理直和；localized-chern-pre-independent（10300 起）与 independent-loc-chern-bQ（11164 起）只给「可用哪一组 $(W, b, Q, T')$ 计算类」的自由度；base-change-loc-chern（10823 起）只给拉回相容；linebundle-formulae（5774 起）在本条内只被用来支撑 $i_0^* = i_1^*$ 这一条推理规则；envelope-bivariant（6706 起）只给 envelope 上类的唯一性；additivity-on-perfect（9426–9491：陈述 9426–9448，证明 9450–9491）只被用来借「(2)(a),(2)(b),(2)(c) 蕴含 (2)(d)」的论证（11375–11377）。没有任何被引件以三角形可加性为结论，也没有任何被引件提供这个形变构造。(2) 该机制被同章下一条引理整段复用，说明它是本证明建立、由书内他处取用的机制：lemma-additivity-loc-chern-P 的证明逐字写「The proof is exactly the same as the proof of / Lemma \ref{lemma-additivity-loc-chern-c} / except it uses / Lemma \ref{lemma-localized-chern-pre-sum-P} / at the very end.」（11512–11515）——即「归约由本条承担、直和情形换成另一条被引件」的架构是书自己点明的。(3) 形态属判据的「建立」一侧：自造对象（$X'$、$Z'$、$\mathcal{C}^\bullet$）+ 自组织归约（三角形 ⇒ 直和，即『This reduces us to the case discussed in the next paragraph.』11439）+ 自造机制（$t$-形变与两端纤维识别）；它不是「验证更大结果的假设」，不是按定义检查，也不是拼装已陈述的等价（被引件里没有这条归约、也没有这条等价）。

【据此为何判该档】按 H3 硬判据（决定性的一步由本证明完成而非被引用），决定性的一步（三角形 ⇒ 直和的归约及其形变构造）由本证明承担；同时本条要求的机器（perfect 复形的局部化 Chern 类、envelope、MacPherson 图构造、截断 bivariant 代数 $A^{(p)}$、$\mathbf{A}^1$-同伦）远高于通常博士资格考试，故判 H3。

【须如实标注的反方向读法：H2（认真权衡后不采纳）】本条唯一真正在 Chow 环里做计算的一步——直和情形的乘性 $c^{(p + p')}(Q \oplus Q') = c^{(p)}(Q)c^{(p')}(Q')$（pre-sum-c，陈述 10498–10517、证明 10519–10600，82 行，含 $i \geq p$、$j \geq p'$ 与混合共三种情形的 bivariant 计算）——整体被引（11477–11478「Thus the desired equality follows from / Lemma \ref{lemma-localized-chern-pre-sum-c}.」）；形变论证赖以推进的两条推理规则也都被引：base change 相容（11418–11419、11428 引 base-change-loc-chern）与 $i_0^* = i_1^*$（11433–11435 引 linebundle-formulae）；envelope 归约（11365–11372）由被引的 envelope-bivariant 与 base-change-loc-chern 拼装；(a)(b)(c) ⇒ (d) 也是借他处证明（11375–11377）；断言所比较的对象（$E_i$、$Z$、$X$、$c^{(p)}$）全部由题面/定义给出，本证明不造它们，只是把类在 $\mathbf{A}^1$-族上搬运并核对「类有定义」。若审阅者把「决定性的一步」认定为 Chow 环里的乘性计算（本证明一次也没做这种计算），或采用「归约 + 被引引擎 ⇒ H2」的口径（对照本语料 judge6/B6-06 对 spaces-chow.tex key formula 的判法：那里第一、二、三步的每一处推进都由被引引理逐点许可、「无一自造机制」，故判 H2），则应判 H2。我不采纳该读法的理由：本条断言的对象是三角形，而 pre-sum-c 只覆盖直和，使断言超出被引输入的那一步恰是形变归约；该步没有被任何被引件逐点许可，是自造对象 + 自组织归约，落在判据的「建立」一侧而非「核对」一侧，故硬判据的「本证明承担」成立。

【其余条款】本条非双射/等价断言 ⇒「两个方向的机制都要看／任一方向的机制整体来自被引件则整条至多 H2」条款不适用；本条非 (a)+(b) 合取式断言（(a)–(d) 是假设中的析取）⇒「判整条，不判其中最漂亮的一段」不因合取而触发（但我已按整条判：它同时含核对段 11360–11362、拼装段 11365–11378 与自造段 11381–11439，档位是对整条给出的）。不判 H1：本条不是定义展开或形式推论，含 121 行、10 处被引、一处自造形变。不判 ineligible：本条是 Stacks Project 的 lemma，自带作者证明（\begin{proof} 11359 至 \end{proof} 11479），非「proof omitted」。

【谁承担】被引件整体承担，共三处：Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma \ref{spaces-morphisms-lemma-large-enough}（dump 3057-3058 选 $k$ 使 "cardinality is larger than $\lambda(R)$"，3062-3064 直接 "Hence by … we conclude there exists an $\overline{r} \in R(k)$"，即 (1)$\Rightarrow$(3) 一句引理拿下）、Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma \ref{spaces-morphisms-lemma-locally-finite-type-surjective-geometric-points}（dump 3094-3096，(1)$\Rightarrow$(4) 的收尾）、以及 auxiliaries \ref{spaces-morphisms-lemma-permanence-finite-type}、\ref{spaces-morphisms-lemma-base-change-finite-type}（dump 3091-3093，把局部有限型搬到 $Z \to \Spec(k)$）。本证明在这两处**没有自造任何机制**：既未自建基数阈值，也未自建「点提升为 $k$-点」的论证，只是把题面假设代进引理的假设、把引理结论抄回目标。
【据此为何判该档】按硬判据「决定性的一步（下界、存在性或核心构造）是由本证明完成的，还是被引用的？被引用则至多 H2」——本条的核心构造（大基数域上的 $k$-点存在性）由被引件承担，本证明只承担 (2)$\Rightarrow$(1) 的图追踪与域扩张记账，故至多 H2。又本条断言的是四条陈述的等价，属「双射或等价」型：两个方向的机制都要看，而 (1)$\Rightarrow$(3) 与 (1)$\Rightarrow$(4) 这两支的机制整体来自被引件，按「只要其中一个方向的机制整体来自被引件，整条至多 H2」直接封顶。再按建立/核对的区分：本条断言所涉及的对象（$R, U, j$，及经由 Equation (\ref{equation-list}) 给出的 $j_{diag}, j_{flip}, j_{comp}$）**全是题面给出的**，证明做的是逐条验证 $\sim_R$ 的对称/自反/传递与四条陈述互推，属「核对 + 拼装已陈述的等价」，亦指向 H2。按「判整条，不判其中最漂亮的一段」，不因 (2)$\Rightarrow$(1) 那支自造交换图与域的四点图较实质而上抬为 H3；也不因证明页内尚有细节未做（三处 "(details omitted)"，dump 3019、3079）而下压为 H1——其技术内容（代数空间的点 vs $k$-点、基数阈值、$j_{comp}$/$j_{diag}$/$j_{flip}$ 三条像包含）确实高于通常博士资格考。

S001-more-morphisms-lemma-thicken-proper.difficulty_reason: Statement (b10-dump.txt lines 3235-3256): for a morphism of thickenings (f,f'):(X subset X') -> (S subset S') with X = S x_{S'} X', S subset S' a finite order thickening, eleven properties P of f hold iff they hold for f'. The substance is entirely the reverse direction, and the proof says so itself (line 3275-3276): 'The interesting direction in each case is therefore to assume that f has the property and deduce that f' has it too.' Forward direction is pure citation: 'The properties P listed in the lemma are all stable under base change, hence if f' has property P, then so does f' (3259-3261), discharged by a block of eleven cited base-change lemmas (Schemes 3262-3263; Morphisms 3266-3272) - that half alone would be H2 assembly. What makes the whole lemma H3 is the reverse half, which the proof establishes by its own mechanism: (i) induction on the order of the thickening to reach a first order thickening, 'By induction on the order of the thickening we may assume that S subset S' is a first order thickening' (3277-3278, citing only the discussion after Definition \ref{definition-thickening} for the notion, not for the step); (ii) a self-devised affine reduction, 3283-3301, which constructs A' = A/I, B' with V' cap X = Spec(B'/IB') and the commutative diagram with exact rows 3289-3300 together with the first-order condition 'with exact rows and I^2 = 0' (3301) - this square is the working object, and it is built here, not quoted; (iii) per-property algebraic proofs carried out in this diagram: (1) surjectivity of A' -> B' from surjectivity of A -> B by Nakayama (3304-3306); (2) finite type by Nakayama applied to a self-chosen surjection A'[x_1,...,x_n] -> B' over the given A[x_1,...,x_n] -> B (3309-3313); (5) the differentials case, 3326-3331, which needs the identification 'we have 0 = Omega_{B/A} = Omega_{B'/A'}/I Omega_{B'/A'}' (3329) and then kills the module by Nakayama - the I^2 = 0 input plus Nakayama is exactly the infinitesimal-lifting mechanism, not an appeal to a ready-made 'thickenings preserve P' theorem; (6) unramified assembled from the proof's own (2) and (5) (3334-3338). Allowable citations are only standard toolbox items: Algebra Nakayama (3306, 3311, 3331) and Algebra differentials-base-change (3328). Several parts are explicitly assembly and are not what the mark rests on: (3),(4) reduce to fibre checks by definition/cited characterization (3316-3323); (7),(8) reduce to the companion Lemma \ref{lemma-thicken-property-morphisms} plus the textbook decompositions of proper and finite (3341-3350). The two parts with real independent content beyond the affine computation are (9) and (10). (9) monomorphisms, 3353-3366: from 'As f is a monomorphism we have X = X x_S X' (3353) the proof applies its own earlier results to the new morphism of thickenings (X subset X') -> (X x_S X subset X' x_{S'} X') (3354-3355), gets a closed immersion by its own (1), then argues the thickened diagonal is a first order thickening because the defining ideal sits inside the pullback of the ideal cutting out S (3357-3360), and finishes with Omega_{X'/S'} = 0 via its own (5) plus the corresponding statement for X/S (3362-3366) so that the cited Morphisms diagonal-differential criterion (3363) applies. This is a self-organized reduction whose input object X' x_{S'} X' is manufactured by the proof. (10) immersions, 3369-3374: factor f = X -> U -> S into open immersion plus closed immersion (given by the definition of immersion), replace U by the open subscheme U' subset S' with the same underlying space (constructed in the proof, 3371-3372), observe the factorisation X' -> U' -> S' and invoke its own (1). Note the statement's hypothesis X = S x_{S'} X' is used as a given condition (3277 onward, and 3361 'Indeed, X = X x_S X = (X' x_{S'} X') x_{S'} S is contained in X'), and the objects the proof must reason about - A, B, I, the first-order square, the thickened diagonal - are obtained from it by the proof's own constructions; the nilpotent ideal and the exact rows are created inside the proof, so this is establishment rather than axiom-checking. Not ineligible: the result is a correct, citable research-level lemma with a full proof; the baseline is far above a qualifying-exam exercise, since the solver must invent the induction to first order, the affine square with I^2 = 0, and the diagonal thickening argument. Verdict H3: the decisive step - converting 'P(f) implies P(f')' through a self-constructed first-order affine diagram, with the monomorphism and immersion cases reduced by the proof's own (1),(5) - is borne by this proof; only the easy base-change half and the standard Nakayama/differential lemmas are quoted. Verbatim quotations above follow the dump's line wrapping (spaces collapsed at line joins); no wording altered.
S001-more-morphisms-lemma-thicken-proper.h3_criterion_note: Decisive step: the reverse implication of all eleven equivalences, i.e. P(f) => P(f'), for finite order thickenings. Who bears it: this proof. It sets the reduction itself ('By induction on the order of the thickening we may assume that S subset S' is a first order thickening', 3277-3278), constructs the affine first-order square ('with exact rows and I^2 = 0', 3289-3301), and proves the algebra translations in that square, the loaded ones being (1) surjectivity by Nakayama (3304-3306), (2) finite type by Nakayama on a self-chosen A'[x_1,...,x_n] -> B' (3309-3313), (5) 'By Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-differentials-base-change} we have 0 = Omega_{B/A} = Omega_{B'/A'}/I Omega_{B'/A'}. Hence Omega_{B'/A'} = 0 by Nakayama's lemma' (3327-3331) - the nilpotent-ideal mechanism is created here - plus (9) via the self-manufactured thickened diagonal (3353-3366) and (10) via a self-chosen U' subset S' (3369-3374). What is merely referenced: the whole forward direction, 'The properties P listed in the lemma are all stable under base change, hence if f' has property P, then so does f' (3259-3261), together with the eleven cited base-change lemmas (3262-3272); the companion Lemma \ref{lemma-thicken-property-morphisms} used only to assemble (7),(8) (3341-3350); and standard toolbox lemmas (Nakayama 3306/3311/3331, differentials-base-change 3328, diagonal-differentials 3363). Judged on the whole lemma rather than its prettiest part: many parts (3),(4),(7),(8) are indeed assembly and would alone be H2, but the lemma's core assertions (1),(2),(5),(6),(9),(10) each require a step the proof itself performs, and no cited result states 'finite order thickenings transfer P'. Since the properties asserted range over objects (A, B, I, the first-order square, X' x_{S'} X', U') that this proof derives from the hypothesis X = S x_{S'} X' rather than merely checking axioms of given ones, the item is establishment, not verification; hence H3 and not H2.

criterion_correction_20261010.what: H3 需同时满足三条：(i) 决定性的一步由本证明承担【必要条件】；(ii) 结果本身研究级/奠基性；(iii) 不是常规辅助步骤。

criterion_correction_20261010.evidence: 两位复核员在本条上一致判 H2 并各自援引计划 §2.3 的 H3 行排除条款。
criterion_correction_20261010.action: judging brief 自下一批起加入第 (iii) 条；本条的档位已由 H3 改为 H2。
criterion_correction_20261010.open_risk: 本修正之前判出的 41 条 H3 都是在【缺 (iii) 的 brief】下复核的 ⇒ 它们若偏宽，那套 brief 抓不出来。我无法声称早先的 H3 计数是干净的；复查这 41 条记为欠账工作，不以『它们都复核过』搪塞。
